title: Variable Neighborhood Trust Region Search
text: R package implements variable neighborhood trust region search (VNTRS) algorithm nonlinear global optimization, following Bierlaire et al. (2009) “Heuristic Nonlinear Global Optimization”. method combines neighborhood exploration trust-region framework search solution space efficiently. can terminate local search early iterates converge toward previously visited local optimum improvement within current region unlikely. algorithm can also used identify multiple local optima.

title: Variable Neighborhood Trust Region Search
text: Specify function f computes objective value. may also return gradient Hessian. Return either numeric value named list value, gradient, hessian components. Omitted derivatives approximated finite differences. Call vntrs::vntrs(f = f, npar = npar, minimize = minimize), npar number parameters f minimize determines whether f minimized (minimize = TRUE, default) maximized (minimize = FALSE). Optionally, algorithm can tuned setting dedicated control arguments (example init_runs neighbors, see help("vntrs") details).

title: Variable Neighborhood Trust Region Search
text: example minimizes well-known six-hump camel function, two global minima.
code: set.seed(1)  camel <- function(x) {   x1 <- x[1]   x2 <- x[2]   value <- (4 - 2.1 * x1^2 + x1^4 / 3) * x1^2 + x1 * x2 + (-4 + 4 * x2^2) * x2^2   gradient <- c(     8 * x1 - 8.4 * x1^3 + 2 * x1^5 + x2,     x1 - 8 * x2 + 16 * x2^3   )   hessian <- matrix(     c(       8 - 25.2 * x1^2 + 10 * x1^4, 1,       1, -8 + 48 * x2^2     ),     nrow = 2,     byrow = TRUE   )   list(value = value, gradient = gradient, hessian = hessian) }  vntrs::vntrs(   f = camel,           # objective supplies value, gradient, Hessian   npar = 2,            # two variables (x1 and x2)   init_runs = 5,       # start from 5 random points   neighborhoods = 5,   # try 5 neighborhood radii per trust region   neighbors = 5,       # evaluate 5 trial points per neighborhood   lower = c(-3, -2),   # lower search bounds for x1 and x2   upper = c(3, 2),     # upper search bounds for x1 and x2   collect_all = TRUE,  # also look for local optima   quiet = FALSE        # show status messages ) #> Initialize VNTRS. #> * Apply local search at 5 random starting points. #> ** Run 1 [0 s] [found optimum] [optimum is unknown] #> ** Run 2 [0 s] [found optimum] [optimum is unknown] #> ** Run 3 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Run 4 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Run 5 [0 s] [found optimum] #> Start VNTRS. #> * Select neighborhood 1. #> ** Neighbor 1 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 2 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 3 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 4 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 5 [0 s] [found optimum] #> * Select neighborhood 2. #> ** Neighbor 1 [0 s] [found optimum] [optimum is unknown] #> ** Neighbor 2 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 3 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 4 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 5 [0 s] [found optimum] #> * Select neighborhood 3. #> ** Neighbor 1 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 2 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 3 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 4 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 5 [0 s] [found optimum] #> * Select neighborhood 4. #> ** Neighbor 1 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 2 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 3 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 4 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 5 [0 s] [found optimum] #> * Select neighborhood 5. #> ** Neighbor 1 [0 s] [found optimum] [optimum is unknown] #> ** Neighbor 2 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 3 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 4 [0 s] [found optimum] #> ** Neighbor 5 [0 s] [found optimum] #> Done. #>            p1         p2      value global #> 1  0.08984201 -0.7126564 -1.0316285   TRUE #> 2 -0.08984201  0.7126564 -1.0316285   TRUE #> 3  1.70360671 -0.7960836 -0.2154638  FALSE #> 4 -1.70360671  0.7960836 -0.2154638  FALSE

title: Variable neighborhood trust region search — vntrs
text: f [function] function accepts numeric parameter vector returns either numeric objective value, list value optional gradient hessian components. Missing derivatives approximated finite differences. npar [integer(1)] number parameters f. minimize [logical(1)] TRUE, minimize f; otherwise, maximize . init_runs [integer(1)] Number random starting points initialization stage. init_min, init_max [numeric(1)] Lower upper bounds uniform initialization range. init_iterlim [integer(1)] Maximum trust-region iterations initialization. neighborhoods [integer(1)] Number neighborhood expansions try. neighbors [integer(1)] Number trial points sampled neighborhood. beta [numeric(1)] Non-negative scaling factor neighborhood expansion. iterlim [integer(1)] Maximum trust-region iterations main search. tolerance [numeric(1)] Maximum relative parameter difference two solutions treated optimum. inferior_tolerance [numeric(1)] Maximum objective-value gap best known solution local optimum discarded early. time_limit [numeric(1) | NULL] Optional time limit seconds. reached, search stops early warning. lower, upper [numeric(npar) | NULL] Optional lower upper parameter bounds. Use NULL unbounded dimensions. collect_all [logical(1)] TRUE, keep converged local optima disable early stopping optima inferior best known solution. quiet [logical(1)] TRUE, suppress progress messages. gradient_tolerance [numeric(1)] Positive convergence tolerance scaled gradient.
